<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-DB-002</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Database</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Server log; PostgreSQL log</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>sorry, too many clients already</span></div>

## Why it happens

The connection pools of SENTIENT, plus backups and other tools, want more connections than PostgreSQL's `max_connections`. PostgreSQL's own default of 25 is smaller than SENTIENT's pools, so a database started without SENTIENT's settings hits this at once.

## Fix it

Set `max_connections` to at least 100 (the compose files do), or lower `DB_POOL_PRIMARY_MAX` and `DATABASE_POOL_MAX` so that together they stay below it. Restart PostgreSQL after changing `max_connections`.

## Check that it worked

The error no longer appears after a restart.
